candidates.reason: Selected: the maker describes a working comparison tool covering GPU specifications, workload estimates, and pricing from dozens of providers. A narrow scheduled tracker is feasible to prototype; price accuracy and product demand remain unproven. No matching product or topic appears among the four existing posts.

candidates.title: Modelship model cluster

candidates.title: ManimGX 3D video engine

candidates.title: SqlFlow durable workflow engine

candidates.title: Open Components design standard
